# Fire Prevention Services - The University of Texas at Austin

> > Official fire safety and prevention resource for UT Austin campus, providing fire code compliance, inspections, emergency planning, and training services.

Fire Prevention Services (FPS), led by Fire Marshal Joshua Lambert, ensures NFPA fire code compliance across UT Austin's campus facilities, residence halls, and special events. The department provides fire extinguisher training, evacuation procedures, permits for outdoor cooking and tents, and coordinates with Austin Fire Department for comprehensive campus fire safety.

## Key Topics

- Fire Prevention Services (FPS)
- Fire Marshal Joshua Lambert
- NFPA fire code compliance
- Fire extinguisher training and inspection
- Campus fire safety and emergency preparedness
- Special events permitting
- Evacuation training and fire drills
- Residence hall fire safety systems
- Austin Fire Department coordination
- Building inspections and code compliance
- Outdoor cooking and open flame permits
- Texas State Fire Marshal's Office
- Emergency procedures and planning
- Student housing fire safety

## Core Services & About

- [Welcome to Fire Prevention Services](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/home): Homepage for UT Austin Fire Prevention Services and campus safety programs
- [About Fire Prevention Services](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/about): Overview of FPS mission, operations, and Fire Marshal Joshua Lambert
- [Our Services](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/about/our-services): FPS services including inspections, NFPA 101 compliance, and emergency planning
- [Fire Safety](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety): Main fire safety hub covering prevention and emergency preparedness at UT

## Fire Extinguishers & Training

- [Fire Extinguishers on Campus](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/fire-extinguishers-campus): Guide to fire extinguisher types, locations, and inspection on campus
- [Portable Fire Extinguisher Training](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/fire-extinguishers-campus/portable-fire-extinguisher-training): UTLearn fire extinguisher training registration for employees and students
- [Inspecting your Fire Extinguisher](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/fire-extinguishers-campus/inspecting-your-fire-extinguisher): Monthly visual inspection procedures for fire extinguishers on campus

## Permits & Special Events

- [Special Events Permitting](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/special-events-permitting): FPS Events Permitting Portal for tents, cooking, and campus events
- [Student Events](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/student-events): Fire safety permits and crowd management for Texas Union student events
- [Standard Operating Procedures](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/standard-operating-procedures): SOPs for fire safety permits, outdoor cooking, and special events (FPS-SOP)

## Emergency Preparedness & Evacuation

- [Evacuation Training](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/evacuation-training): Fire drill and evacuation procedures training by Stacey Alley
- [Campus Residence Halls](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/campus-residence-halls): Fire safety systems and drills in University Housing and Dining facilities
- [Off-Campus Housing](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/campus-housing): Fire safety guide for off-campus student housing in Austin area

## Compliance & Reports

- [Records & Reports](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/records-reports): Annual Security and Fire Safety Report with residence hall statistics
- [Deck the Halls with Fire Safety](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/fire-safety/deck-halls-fire-safety): Holiday decoration safety guide covering NFPA 1 Fire Code requirements

## Contact & Resources

- [Contact Us](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/contact-us): Staff directory including Fire Marshal Joshua Lambert and inspectors
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/firesafety/frequently-asked-questions): FAQ covering fire safety, extinguisher training, and evacuation procedures
- [Fire Safety Links](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/firesafety/fire-safety-links): External fire safety resources including AFD and Texas State Fire Marshal

- [Organizational Chart](https://fireprevention.utexas.edu/about/organizational-chart): FPS department structure under John Salsman and Operational Safety
